meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 装上后,每次 Bash 调用都会自动经 rtk 代理过滤,压缩 git、cargo、pytest 等开发命令的输出(原文称省 60–90% token)。该技能会在主机装 rtk、挂载进容器并写入 PreToolUse 钩子。
howto.when: 原文未写触发条件;按流程,它在你要求给某个 agent 容器装 rtk、想为 git、cargo 等开发命令省 token 时执行,对每个目标 group 逐一安装。

say.text: 给这个 agent group 装上 rtk
say.note: 安装 rtk 并挂载进容器

say.text: 把 rtk 挂到组 ag-xxx 并加上 PreToolUse 钩子
say.note: 写完钩子后需重启容器

say.text: 跑 rtk gain 看看省了多少 token

howto.what_en: After install, every Bash call is filtered through the rtk proxy, compressing output of dev commands like git, cargo and pytest (60–90% token savings claimed). It installs rtk, mounts it into containers, and writes a PreToolUse hook.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want rtk installed into an agent container for token savings on dev commands; it runs per target group.

say_en.text: Install rtk into this agent group
say_en.note: Installs rtk and mounts it into the container

say_en.text: Mount rtk into group ag-xxx and add the PreToolUse hook
say_en.note: Restart the container after the hook is written

say_en.text: Run rtk gain to see the token savings
